name: Should multigenerational homes have separate HVAC zones?

mainEntity.name: Should multigenerational homes have separate HVAC zones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, individual thermostats and ductless mini-splits for private suites allow temperature preferences while shared areas maintain comfortable communal temperatures.
